verses.text: The LORD's message came to me:
"Son of man, turn your face toward the mountains of Israel and prophesy against them.

Say, 'Mountains of Israel, listen to the message of the Lord GOD! This is what the Lord GOD says to the mountains and hills, to the ravines and valleys: Look, I myself am going to bring a sword against you, and I will destroy your high places.
Your altars will be torn down, and your incense altars will be smashed. I will throw down your dead in front of your idols.
I will lay the dead bodies of the people of Israel in front of their idols, and I will scatter your bones around your altars.

Wherever you live, the towns will be ruined and the high places torn down. Your altars will be ruined and destroyed, your idols smashed and gone, your incense altars cut down, and everything you have made wiped out.
Your people will fall dead among you, and you will know that I am the LORD.
But I will spare some of you. Some will escape the sword and be scattered among the nations and countries.

Then those who escape will remember me in the nations where they have been taken captive. They will remember how I was hurt by their unfaithful hearts, which turned away from me, and by their eyes, which chased after their idols. They will hate themselves for the evil they have done and for all their disgusting practices.
And they will know that I am the LORD. I did not threaten in vain to bring this disaster on them.'

This is what the Lord GOD says: Clap your hands, stamp your feet, and cry out, 'How terrible!' because of all the evil and disgusting things the people of Israel have done. They will fall by war, famine, and disease.
Those far away will die of disease. Those nearby will fall by the sword. Those who are left and survive the siege will die of hunger. That is how I will spend my fury on them.

They will know that I am the LORD when their dead lie among their idols around their altars, on every high hill and on all the mountaintops, under every green tree and every leafy oak, the places where they offered sweet-smelling incense to all their idols.
I will stretch out my hand against them and make the land a desolate wasteland everywhere they live, from the desert to Diblah. Then they will know that I am the LORD."
